title: Dealer Further Diagnosis Guidance
summary: This topic centers on service writers advising owners to contact dealers for further diagnosis, mixed with a few explanatory feature notes that do not clearly express satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe service guidance as helpful by recommending dealer diagnosis or outlining next steps to address the concern.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe unresolved problems that required further dealer diagnosis or pending software action instead of an immediate fix.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly relay procedural advice or feature explanations, such as recommending diagnosis or explaining how functions work, without clear praise or complaint.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and simply restate advisor guidance, which limits clear sentiment interpretation.
The examples mix dealer-diagnosis instructions with unrelated feature explanations, so the topic is not fully coherent around a single vehicle issue.
Several positive examples are brief and provide limited detail about the outcome or customer experience.
